# EssayLabsg™

> Essay marking for Singapore exam students: PSLE, O-Level, A-Level General Paper, IB and IGCSE. It marks them against the published SEAB, Cambridge and IB criteria. EssayLabsg™ is a product of Thinking Hack™.

## 2025 results
PSLE English 98% AL1/2, PSLE Maths 100% AL1/2, PSLE Science 96% AL1/2, O-Level English 98% A1, GP 98% A/B.

## Pricing
- Free: 3 instant markings for PSLE English, O-Level English and A-Level GP. The first needs no sign-up, the other 2 need an email. Ready in about a minute.
- Detailed feedback: S$39 for 4 essays, marked by Exam Preparation Specialists™, within 48 hours. Available as a monthly plan or a one-off 31-day pass. Covers all 13 papers.
